tasks.title: Implement Custom Firebase MCP Server Extensions
tasks.description: Extend the custom-firebase MCP server with basic Firebase Storage integration and core storage tools, including 'storage_get_file_content', 'storage_upload_file', 'storage_list_files', 'storage_delete_file', and 'storage_get_file_info'. This task is a high priority and should be completed before implementing the storage structure.
tasks.details: Use the latest version of the custom-firebase library and follow best practices for server-side development. Implement basic error handling and logging to ensure reliable performance. Integrate Firebase Storage SDK and implement core storage tools with support for text and binary file types, and proper error handling. Ensure consistent JSON response formatting matching existing Firestore tools. This task is crucial for enabling further development of the storage structure.
tasks.testStrategy: Write unit tests for each new function to verify correct behavior and basic error handling. Integrate the MCP server extensions with the existing CK_Priming_v11 system and validate end-to-end functionality for core storage operations. Ensure thorough testing due to the high priority of this task.

subtasks.title: Implement environment variable loading
subtasks.description: Create a function to load environment variables from a .env file or system environment
subtasks.details: Use a library like dotenv to load variables from a .env file. Fall back to system environment variables if not found in the file. Add support for FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET environment variable.

subtasks.title: Develop configuration validation
subtasks.description: Create a function to validate the presence and format of required configuration values
subtasks.details: Check for the presence of critical variables like API keys, endpoints, and storage bucket. Validate the format of values where applicable (e.g., URL format for endpoints). Enhance existing service account path configuration validation to include storage permissions.

subtasks.title: Implement error handling for missing configuration
subtasks.description: Create a mechanism to handle and report missing or invalid configuration values
subtasks.details: Develop a custom error class for configuration issues. Implement error throwing for missing critical values and logging for non-critical issues. Include storage-specific configuration error handling.

subtasks.title: Create a configuration access interface
subtasks.description: Develop a clean interface for other modules to access configuration values
subtasks.details: Create getter methods for each configuration value, including storage-specific configurations. Implement caching to avoid repeated environment lookups.

subtasks.title: Integrate configuration module with MCP server extension
subtasks.description: Modify the MCP server extension to use the new configuration module for accessing settings
subtasks.details: Update the MCP server extension to use the new configuration interface instead of directly accessing environment variables. Ensure all necessary configuration values are accessible, including storage-related configurations.

subtasks.title: Implement Firebase Storage SDK integration and core storage tools
subtasks.description: Integrate Firebase Storage SDK and implement the five essential storage tools
subtasks.details: Import { getStorage } from 'firebase-admin/storage'. Initialize storage with default bucket using const storage = getStorage(); const bucket = storage.bucket(). Implement storage authentication verification. Create the following functions: storage_get_file_content(path, encoding?), storage_upload_file(path, content, contentType?, metadata?), storage_list_files(directoryPath?, prefix?), storage_delete_file(path), and storage_get_file_info(path). Ensure support for text and binary file types, basic error handling, file path validation and sanitization, and consistent JSON response formatting.

subtasks.title: Perform final testing and integration
subtasks.description: Conduct thorough testing of all implemented storage tools and ensure seamless integration with the existing system
subtasks.details: Perform comprehensive unit and integration tests for all implemented storage functions. Verify error handling, edge cases, and performance under various conditions. Ensure that the MCP server extensions work correctly with the CK_Priming_v11 system. Document any potential impacts on the upcoming storage structure implementation.

tasks.title: Upload B1 Section Documents to Firebase Storage
tasks.description: Upload the B1 section documents from the local folder to the '/bible/sections/B1/raw/' directory in Firebase Storage.
tasks.details: Use the 'storage_upload_document' function to upload each document with the appropriate metadata. Ensure file integrity and no data loss during the upload process.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that all B1 section documents are successfully uploaded to Firebase Storage and that the file contents match the local copies.

subtasks.title: Implement create/update template function
subtasks.description: Develop a function to create and update B1 document templates in the API client module
subtasks.details: Create a function that accepts template data, constructs the payload, sends a POST/PUT request to the API, and handles the response. Include error handling and validation of input data.

subtasks.title: Implement get template function
subtasks.description: Develop a function to retrieve B1 document templates from the API
subtasks.details: Create a function that sends a GET request to the API to fetch template data. Handle pagination if applicable, and process the response to return the template information.

subtasks.title: Implement B1 document upload process
subtasks.description: Create a function to handle the B1 document upload process, including subsections B1.1-B1.6
subtasks.details: Develop a function that takes B1 document data, validates it against the template, and uploads each subsection (B1.1-B1.6) to the appropriate location in Firebase Storage. Ensure proper organization and naming conventions.

subtasks.title: Implement error handling and HTTP response management
subtasks.description: Create utility functions for managing HTTP responses and handling errors consistently across the API client module
subtasks.details: Develop reusable functions for processing HTTP responses, extracting relevant data, and standardizing error handling. Implement logging for errors and unexpected responses.

tasks.title: Create Metadata Records in Firestore
tasks.description: Create metadata records for the B1 section documents in the 'bible_storage_metadata' Firestore collection.
tasks.details: For each B1 document, create a new record in the 'bible_storage_metadata' collection with the following fields: 'section', 'title', 'storage_path', 'optimized_path', 'chunks', 'cross_references', and 'metadata'.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate that all B1 section documents have corresponding metadata records in the 'bible_storage_metadata' collection, and that the records contain the expected fields and values.

tasks.title: Generate Initial Cross-Reference Mapping
tasks.description: Implement the 'bible_update_cross_references' function to generate the initial cross-reference mapping for the B1 section documents.
tasks.details: Analyze the content of the B1 documents and create cross-reference records in the 'bible_cross_references' Firestore collection. Each record should include the 'source_document', 'target_document', 'reference_type', 'context', and 'confidence' fields.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the 'bible_cross_references' collection contains accurate and comprehensive cross-reference data for the B1 section documents. Manually review a sample of the cross-references to ensure they are contextually relevant.

tasks.title: Upload B0_README_TOC.md as Master Index
tasks.description: Upload the B0_README_TOC.md file to the '/bible' directory in Firebase Storage as the master table of contents for the Bible documentation.
tasks.details: Use the 'storage_upload_document' function to upload the B0_README_TOC.md file. Ensure the file is accessible and up-to-date with the latest section information.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the B0_README_TOC.md file is successfully uploaded and that the table of contents accurately reflects the available Bible sections.

tasks.title: Analyze B1 Documents for Structure and Content Patterns
tasks.description: Analyze the B1 section documents to identify structural and content patterns that can be used to optimize the documents for AI consumption.
tasks.details: Use natural language processing and machine learning techniques to detect document structure, semantic relationships, and key information. Identify opportunities to extract and organize the content into more AI-friendly formats.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate the analysis results by manually reviewing a sample of the B1 documents and comparing the identified patterns to the original content. Ensure the analysis accurately captures the essential information and structure.

tasks.title: Generate Semantic Chunks for B1 Documents
tasks.description: Based on the analysis from the previous task, generate semantic chunks of the B1 section documents and store them in the '/bible/sections/B1/chunks/' directory.
tasks.details: Develop an algorithm to split the B1 documents into logically coherent chunks, preserving the context and relationships between the content. Store the chunks in a structured format (e.g., JSON) that can be easily consumed by AI systems.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the generated chunks accurately represent the original document content and maintain the necessary context and relationships. Ensure the chunk data is stored in a format that is easily accessible and usable by the CK_Priming_v11 system.

tasks.title: Create Optimized Versions of B1 Documents
tasks.description: Generate optimized versions of the B1 section documents and store them in the '/bible/sections/B1/optimized/' directory.
tasks.details: Based on the analysis and chunk generation, create AI-friendly versions of the B1 documents that are structured, annotated, and formatted to improve their usability for the CK_Priming_v11 system. Leverage the latest natural language processing and content optimization techniques to enhance the documents.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate the optimized documents by comparing them to the original versions and ensuring that the essential information and context are preserved. Verify that the optimized documents provide improved performance and usability for the CK_Priming_v11 system.

tasks.title: Implement Automated Cross-Reference Detection and Mapping
tasks.description: Develop an automated process to detect and map cross-references between the B1 section documents.
tasks.details: Enhance the 'bible_update_cross_references' function to automatically analyze the content of the B1 documents, identify relevant cross-references, and update the 'bible_cross_references' Firestore collection accordingly. Leverage natural language processing and machine learning techniques to improve the accuracy and reliability of the cross-reference detection.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate the cross-reference mapping by manually reviewing a sample of the generated relationships and ensuring they are contextually accurate and relevant. Monitor the performance and accuracy of the automated cross-reference detection over time.
